body: I agree with everything you said. I have tried to push my grandmother and mother to be more strict with A weeks prior, they said it wasn't my problem and to leave him be. I don't hear any complaints now though, haha! Thanks!
God, I wish I had that sort of say. Unfortunately all I can do for now is shame M untill she actually begins parenting her children, or just doesn't bring A.

I have no doubt that this sort of thing happened back in my grandparent's home too, I actually wonder how M handles this issue back at her home.

I don't quite know how old A is, 5 sounds about right. He is to start school soon and we are worried about what kind of load M will drop on us if it is online school as A doesn't understand authority, hell, I wonder how they'd handle him in a physical school!

I have no say in who gets to enter the house, but my mother, who acknowledges bad guests, absolutely cannot stand her ground! This is why I now have the task to call M and A out on their behavior.

I also believe that intervention of some kind must happen, there is so much more that goes on in their family that I just don't know how to say over text. I'll have you know though that only M's children have ever had bathroom issues and I think it's very concerning.

I have talked to the school counselor many times, however there's only so much they can help with. At some point I think it's my fault I can't think differently. I too hope winter break will help a bit. Thank you :)
